mapper.select: SELECT KEYWORD, CATE_CD, SUB_CATE_CD FROM TB_EEP_CAL_RULE_M WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY RULE_ORD, RULE_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CAL_CONF_M (CONF_KEY, CONF_VAL, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{CONF_KEY}, #{CONF_VAL}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CONF_VAL = VALUES(CONF_VAL), UPDT_DT = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT T.EVT_TMP_SQ , T.EVT_TITLE , T.EVT_LOC , DATE_FORMAT(T.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS START_DT , DATE_FORMAT(T.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS END_DT , T.ALL_DAY_YN , IFNULL(M.CATE_CD, T.CATE_CD) AS CATE_CD , IF(M.EVT_SQ IS NULL, T.SUB_CATE_CD, M.SUB_CATE_CD) AS SUB_CATE_CD , IF(M.EVT_SQ IS NULL, 'N', 'Y') AS CONFIRM_YN FROM TB_EEP_CAL_EVT_TMP T LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_CAL_EVT_M M ON M.CAL_ID = T.CAL_ID AND M.GCAL_EVT_ID = T.GCAL_EVT_ID WHERE T.REG_EMPLY_ID = #{REG_EMPLY_ID} ORDER BY T.START_DT, T.EVT_TMP_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CAL_EVT_M ( CAL_ID, GCAL_EVT_ID, EVT_TITLE, EVT_DESC, EVT_LOC, START_DT, END_DT, ALL_DAY_YN , CATE_CD, SUB_CATE_CD, CONFIRM_EMPLY_ID, CONFIRM_DT ) SELECT CAL_ID, GCAL_EVT_ID, EVT_TITLE, EVT_DESC, EVT_LOC, START_DT, END_DT, ALL_DAY_YN , CATE_CD, SUB_CATE_CD, #{REG_EMPLY_ID}, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_CAL_EVT_TMP WHERE REG_EMPLY_ID = #{REG_EMPLY_ID} AND EVT_TMP_SQ IN #{sq} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE EVT_TITLE = VALUES(EVT_TITLE), EVT_DESC = VALUES(EVT_DESC), EVT_LOC = VALUES(EVT_LOC) , START_DT = VALUES(START_DT), END_DT = VALUES(END_DT), ALL_DAY_YN = VALUES(ALL_DAY_YN) , CATE_CD = VALUES(CATE_CD), SUB_CATE_CD = VALUES(SUB_CATE_CD) , CONFIRM_EMPLY_ID = VALUES(CONFIRM_EMPLY_ID), CONFIRM_DT = VALUES(CONFIRM_DT)
mapper.sql: WHERE START_DT >= #{FROM_DT} AND START_DT < DATE_ADD(#{TO_DT}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select:
SELECT EVT_SQ , EVT_TITLE , EVT_LOC , DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS START_DT , DATE_FORMAT(END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS END_DT , ALL_DAY_YN , CATE_CD , SUB_CATE_CD , CONFIRM_EMPLY_ID , DATE_FORMAT(CONFIRM_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CONFIRM_DT FROM TB_EEP_CAL_EVT_M
AND CATE_CD = #{CATE_CD} ORDER BY START_DT, EVT_SQ
